page.overview:
Who is Clarence?

Clarence was a male Velociraptor in Jurassic Park. Alan Grant tranquilized him in self defense, and later used him to show that the dinosaurs were breeding.

Clarence was a green male Velociraptor that was one of the offspring of the wild population of Velociraptors living underneath the park.

Alan Grant found Clarence in an underground garage behind an artificial waterfall. Using a tranquilizer gun Grant had recently attained, Clarence is sedated and later used to find the Raptor nest. This Velociraptor had a unique ability to change color like a chameleon, perhaps with emotion; this is much like the Carnotaurus seen in the second novel. He was killed during the Napalm Bombing along with most of the dinosaurs including the baby Triceratops Ralph. Lex cried over his and Ralph's demise.
